title: Proof: Was Activity.onCreate(Bundle) entered through ClassResolver + MethodResolver + DEX Interpreter?
verdict: PARTIAL_PROOF - Entry path verified, execution incomplete
executive_summary: The runtime CORRECTLY resolves and enters the onCreate method through the proper DEX infrastructure (ClassResolver -> MethodResolver -> DEX Interpreter). However, the interpreter only executes the first instruction (const-string) before halting on unimplemented new-instance opcode. The REMAINING onCreate logic is completed via C++ simulation, NOT DEX execution.

proof_requirements.evidence: DexInterpreter::execute() called with correct method context

details.root_cause: Opcode not in allowed set for EXP-003-A scope

proof_requirements.evidence: FALLBACK SIMULATION DETECTED after interpreter halt

details.bypass_nature: Post-halt fallback to maintain pipeline progress
